rationale: This empirical survey examines the relationship between organizational size, subunit structure, naval rank, organizational climate perceptions and job satisfaction among US Navy vessel personnel. It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings because the study is an organizational behaviour survey of US Navy personnel with no relation to household or community water or sanitation service access (E01).

evidence_quotes.quote: Personnel aboard US Navy vessels were surveyed about their perceptions of organizational climate and their job satisfaction.
Only rank was found to positively influence climate perceptions and job satisfaction.
